name: 110 會考模擬二模（翰林 1～4 冊）英語閱讀
source: 翰林 110 學年度國中教育會考模擬測驗（卷面標示第三次，範圍 1～4 冊），答案與解析取自官方試題分析
passages:
【Amy’s science notes】（圖見第 20 題附圖）
skink: Slim, snake-like head. Small eyes. They can blink. Smooth skin. Small legs with slim toes. They can’t climb, but they move faster than geckos. Good swimmers. Different in color and size. The longest one is about 14 cm.
gecko: Wide, frog-like head. Big eyes. They can’t blink. Scaly skin. Big fat legs with wide toes. They’re able to climb on walls. Move slowly. Good at climbing. Different in color and size. The longest one is about 16 cm.
1. They’re both 【nocturnal】 lizards. They sleep during the day and come out to play or look for food at night.
2. Both of them can grow tails back.
3. Both are good at hearing and seeing things.
4. They eat insects or dead animals.
（blink 眨眼　smooth 光滑的　skin 皮膚　scaly 有鱗的　lizard 蜥蜴）

Should we eat something before or after exercising? What and when should we eat? Let’s see the pictures below and find out!
▼ Before exercise, you can eat some carbohydrates to help you do better and exercise longer.
・Drink 500 ml water two to three hours before you exercise.
・Eat some carbohydrates (rice, bananas, noodles) one hour before you exercise.
・Don’t eat fried food before exercise.
▼ When you are exercising, be sure to drink water.
・Drink water every 15 to 20 minutes when you are exercising.
▼ After exercise, eat some protein to help build your muscles.
・Have some water and protein (chicken, eggs) in 0.5 to 2 hours after exercise.
（carbohydrate 碳水化合物　protein 蛋白質　muscle 肌肉）

I am King Adam, a really great king.
So many people and soldiers 【admire】 me.
They love me, cheer for me, and follow my words.
Also I treat them well and kindly.

“Adam, your milk and toast are ready.
Come down to eat. Hurry!”

Next to my country lives King Evil,
And he is mean and bad to his people.
Many of them come here for my help,
So King Evil hates me, not surprisingly.

“Adam, what are you doing?
The school bus is coming in ten minutes!
Hurry to come down, or you’re going to be late again.”

Then one day, King Evil attacks my country.
I lead my soldiers on the horse, so serious and brave,
And his soldiers run away when they see my face.
Great King Adam saves his people again.

Ouch! My ear! What happened?
“Adam, your bus left, and you are late again!”
Oh, no, not again! Ms. Butlof is going to kill me.
Poor me. A great king is in fact a weak little boy.

（漫畫六格，原圖見第 26 題附圖）
1. Linda: Grace, I heard that you are going to get married! Congratulations!
　Grace: Thank you, Linda. After being together for almost ten years, Jason and I finally decided to have a family together, and we’re moving into a new house.
2. Linda: Wow, that’s great! Do you need anything for your new house? I can buy you something as a gift.
　Grace: Actually, we would like 【social gifting】 from our friends.
3. Linda: Social gifting? What’s that?
4. Grace: You don’t give us a real thing, but do something good for the world or people for us, like giving money to a children’s home or helping people in the hospital.
5. Linda: I see. That is really a wonderful idea. We often get gifts but we don’t really need them, and that is a waste. By doing this, we can save the trouble and also do something to make the world better.（圖：兩張沙發；男孩：I only need a sofa.）
6. Grace: Yeah. That’s what I think. After you finish, you can just send me a picture.
　Linda: No problem.
（congratulation 恭喜　waste 浪費）

Jeans are very popular. Almost everyone has at least one pair of jeans. Jacob W. Davis and Levi Strauss first made them for workers in the late 1850s. From 1960, jeans became popular with young people. People usually have more than one pair of jeans now. There are so many different kinds of jeans. Let’s take a look at some of them.
【STRAIGHT JEANS】Straight jeans are the same size from the top to the ankle part. They are classical and fit most body types. If you never try jeans, they should be your first choice.
【FLARED JEANS】Flared jeans started getting popular in the 1970s. They become wider from the knees down, and the pant legs are in a “bell-like” shape. They make people look taller.
【BOYFRIEND JEANS】People started calling these boyfriend jeans because of how they look when a woman wears them! It is like she’s wearing her boyfriend’s big and loose jeans. So, these are the type of comfortable pants.
【SKINNY JEANS】Skinny jeans are so different from boyfriend jeans. As the name says, skinny jeans fit your legs. If you have long and straight legs, 【these】 are just for you! On the other hand, people with round body shapes should not wear them.
（ankle 腳踝　classical 經典的　fit 合身　loose 鬆的）

When we go to the beach, sometimes we will see hermit crabs on the beach. And we all know hermit crabs have to change to bigger shells when they grow bigger. In fact, when they finally find a new shell, they have a special habit: They will tell other hermit crabs to change shells together!
How do they change shells together? When they start to get together, they will stand in line according to their sizes. After the first one (also the biggest one) takes off its shell, the second 【one】 (smaller than the biggest one) puts on the shell of the first one. Then the third one puts on the shell of the second one, and so on. It is interesting, isn’t it?
Why do they change shells this way? In fact, it is not easy to find a new shell. By doing this, the chance of not finding a shell will be smaller. Hermit crabs try their best to live. To help them, please don’t take away shells on the beach, and don’t leave trash on the beach, either. Don’t make them only have to live by taking our trash as their homes.
（hermit crab 寄居蟹　shell 殼　according to 根據）

Look at the three pictures below. Which one do you think is the best deal?
（圖一：3 pencils $15, shipping fee $7／圖二：3 pencils $22, Free Shipping／圖三：1 pencil $20, Buy one and get one free. Pay two more dollars and get one free!）
Most people will think the second or the third one is the best deal. But actually, no matter which you choose, you have to pay the same. You won’t think the first one is good because its shipping fee is almost half price of three pencils. Also, words like “free shipping” or “buy one and get one free” are more eye-catching. It is all about 【marketing strategy】, and that is used to make shoppers want to buy more right away.
Let’s see another example. Which do you think is a better deal for shop owners, “50% off” or “buy one get one free”? If the price of a pencil is $10, you pay $5 for each one no matter it is “50% off” or “buy one get one free.” However, you have to buy two pencils when it is “buy one get one free” while you would only buy one when it is “50% off.” Then can you see which one is better for shop owners? Don’t be fooled and be a smart shopper!
（shipping fee 運費　no matter 無論）

A lost dog walks into a jungle. A lion sees him from far away and thinks, “I never saw this kind of animal before, and he looks weak. Maybe I can eat him for lunch.” So the lion starts running to the dog. The dog notices that and is afraid. Then he sees some bones next to him and comes up with an idea. He says loudly, “Hmm... ＿38＿!”
The lion hears this and stops. He thinks, “Wow, this guy is so much stronger than I ＿39＿. I should leave before he gets me.”
In the tree a monkey sees everything. He thinks if he tells the lion the truth, he ＿40＿ something good from the lion. So the monkey goes to tell the lion what really happened right away. The lion is angry and says, “Get on my back. We’ll get him together!”
They start running to the dog again. The dog sees that and gets even more scared. Then he comes up with another idea and shouts angrily, “＿41＿ I told him to bring me another lion one hour ago!” The lion hears that and feels more afraid. Quickly he runs away with the monkey on his back just like that, even without time to think of the idea that he should teach the monkey a good lesson.
（jungle 叢林　bone 骨頭　truth 事實）

questions.q: What is the man in a cap doing?
questions.e: 由圖片得知，戴棒球帽的男子正在「遛狗」。(A)他正在遛狗(B)他正在野餐(C)他正在打籃球(D)他正在看報紙。

questions.q: _____ Frank hurried to the office as soon as possible, he still missed the important meeting with his boss.
questions.e: 「雖然」盡快趕去公司，仍然錯過和老闆的重要會議，選 although。

questions.q:
Amy: What’s that in the box, Dad? It’s moving.
Dad: Just open it.
Amy: Wow. _____ two puppies in it.
questions.e: 「有」兩隻小狗在箱子裡，表存在的有，而且兩隻狗是複數，因此選(D)。

questions.q: I _____ go to school without eating breakfast. It’s very important to have a good meal at the start of a day.
questions.e: 我「從未」不吃早餐就去上學。一天的開始好好吃一餐很重要。(A)總是(B)從未(C)時常(D)有時候。

questions.q: Those students _____ hard for the race. They exercise for one hour in the morning and run for another hour after school.
questions.e: 那些學生為比賽認真「訓練」。早上運動一小時，下午放學後再跑步一小時，故選(D)。(A)抗爭(B)敲打(C)研讀(D)訓練。

questions.q:
Hank: Did you see Tom hit John in the gym?
Peter: I didn’t _____ see it. I just heard a big noise.
questions.e: Peter 只聽到巨大聲響，並沒有「實際上」看到 Tom 打 John，選(A)。(A)實際上(B)小心地(C)容易地(D)通常。

questions.q: Sorry for not answering your call. I _____ when you called me.
questions.e: 當妳來電時，我「正在開車」。開車是當時持續一段時間進行的動作，用過去進行式。

questions.q: Jason was late for the show, so there was no seat for him. He could only stand _____ the room.
questions.e: Jason 看表演遲到，沒有座位坐。他只能站「在」表演廳「後面」。(A)沿著(B)在…之間(C)在…後面(D)在…底部。

questions.q: I don’t quite understand the question. Could you _____ those words more clearly?
questions.e: 我不太了解這個問題。能否請您再更清楚地「解釋；定義」這些用詞？(A)決定(B)定義(C)下載(D)畫畫。

questions.q:
Sue: You and Tom had dinner at Star Yard yesterday. How was the food there?
Ted: The food was good, but the _____ was slow. It took 30 minutes for our first dish to be on the table.
questions.e: 由 30 分鐘後才上第一道菜得知「服務」很慢，選(D)。(A)選擇(B)價格(C)螢幕(D)服務。

questions.q: Some teenagers like to spend time with their friends in their free time, but _____ just want to kill time by themselves.
questions.e: 一些…，一些…用片語 some..., others / some... 表達，並無特定範圍。

questions.q: Mom always _____ me take care of my little sister when she is not home.
questions.e: 使役動詞用法 have＋受詞＋原形動詞，故選(A)。

questions.q: When Larry asked me to lend him NT$10,000, he said he would pay me back in a week. I, like a _____, believed him. Now I can’t reach him, and there is a slim chance of getting my money back.
questions.e: 我相信 Larry 的話而借給他新臺幣一萬元，現在我聯絡不到他，把錢拿回來的機會渺茫，我就像「傻子」一樣，選(B)。(A)老闆(B)傻子(C)外國人(D)業務員。

questions.q: A _____ knife does an excellent job of cutting food. If your knife is not that good, it cannot make clean cuts.
questions.e: 「鋒利的」刀子有利於切割食物。(A)清楚的(B)新鮮的(C)主要的(D)鋒利的。

questions.q: Of all the different cameras on the table, the largest one is _____.
questions.e: 三者以上作比較，要用最高級。

questions.q: _____ baseball and basketball games is Ted’s favorite. He does that almost every day.
questions.e: 由第一句的單數動詞 is 可知此句應使用動名詞當主詞，指某一件事／動作，故選(D) Watching。

questions.q: Mike is planning a trip to Paris. He wants to know how he can get to different places in or near the pretty city. What words should he type in for the information on the Internet?
questions.e: Mike 想查詢到巴黎各個景點的方式，應該輸入「巴黎地鐵」查詢，選(B)。(A)巴黎飯店(B)巴黎地鐵(C)巴黎節慶(D)巴黎博物館。

questions.q:
Mark didn’t understand what “tip” meant in the reading below:
【I heard Dad shout loudly at my younger sister, “Don’t tip your chair back like that, Linda. You may fall and even get hurt.”】
He looked it up in a dictionary and found more than one meaning. What does “tip” mean here?
o: To put trash in a wrong place.
To give someone money to thank them for their service.
To say that someone has a bigger chance to be successful.
To make something move so that one side is higher than another side.
questions.e: 我的爸爸阻止我的妹妹「把椅子向後傾斜」，以免摔倒甚至受傷，選(D)。

questions.q: Which picture shows nocturnal animals?（選項見圖）
questions.e: 由後面提到的「白天睡覺晚上外出玩耍或覓食。」可知 nocturnal 為「夜行性」的意思。只有貓頭鷹在半夜還醒著，故選(A)。

questions.q: What can we learn from Amy’s science notes?
o: Both lizards are good at climbing.
Geckos can blink, but skinks can’t.
We can tell a gecko from a skink by its legs.
Geckos are good at hearing, but skinks are not.
questions.e: 從圖中得知壁虎的腳大腳趾寬大，石龍子的腳小腳趾細長，故選(C)。(A)石龍子不會爬(B)壁虎不會眨眼，石龍子會(D)兩者都聽力很好。

questions.q: In what kind of news may you see the reading?
questions.e: 整篇文章在提供運動前後飲食的建議，故應該會在跟「健康」相關的新聞看到。

questions.q: Which is the best time to have some protein from the reading?（運動時段為 18:00～19:00，選項見圖）
questions.e: 根據文章，補充蛋白質應在運動後半小時到二小時內，而根據圖表運動時間為 18:00 到 19:00，因此(C) 20:00（一小時後）的時間最適合補充蛋白質。

questions.q: What can we know from the reading?
o: Banana is a kind of protein.
We should drink water before and after exercise.
We shouldn’t eat fried food before exercise because it is not carbohydrate.
To build our muscles, we should have both carbohydrates and protein after exercise.
questions.e: 文章提到運動前二到三小時要喝水，運動後也有說要喝水，因此可知(B)運動前後都要喝水正確。(A)香蕉是碳水化合物(C)未提及(D)只有提到運動後要攝取蛋白質來幫助建造肌肉。

questions.q: What does admire mean in the poem?（poem 詩）
questions.e: 由後句提到人們都愛他並替他歡呼，可知 admire 應是「喜歡」。(B)允許(C)害怕(D)擔心。

questions.q: What can we know from the reading?
o: King Adam was King Evil’s friend before.
King Evil’s soldiers are not afraid of King Adam.
Adam didn’t get up early, so he missed the school bus.
Ms. Butlof is kind to Adam because he is a weak little boy.
questions.e: Adam 做夢、睡過頭，沒趕上校車，選(C)。(A)未提及(B)有提到士兵看到國王 Adam 就逃跑(D)由文中語氣可知 Adam 很怕 Butlof 女士，她對他很嚴厲。

questions.q: Which of the following may be doing social gifting?（上圖為漫畫，下圖為選項）
questions.e: 由第 4 格 Grace 解釋說不要收到真實的東西，而是做一些對世界或人們有幫助的事，可知 social gifting 是做一些好事，故選(B)在海灘撿垃圾。

questions.q: What can we know from the comics?
o: Grace started to date with Jason ten years ago.
Grace got many gifts from Jason but she didn’t like them.
Linda’s house is not big enough for all the gifts from friends.
questions.e: 由第 1 格 Grace 提到跟 Jason 在一起十年後決定結婚，可知她跟 Jason 是 10 年前開始約會的。其餘選項與漫畫內容皆不符合。

questions.q: Which does Linda think is a waste?
o: Billy drinks lots of drinks every day.
Julie goes shopping when she feels down.
Joe spent over twenty thousand NT dollars on his cellphone.
Jessie needed a new bike, and each of her family bought one for her.
questions.e: 由第 5 格「我們常常收到禮物但我們不是真的需要它們」，可知 Jessie 只需一輛腳踏車，多餘的是浪費。

questions.q: Lucy is shopping with her boyfriend. She never wore jeans before, and now she wants to try them. Which is the best pick for her from the reading?
questions.e: 由圖一「如果您從沒有嘗試過牛仔褲，那麼它們應該是您的首選。」可知選(C)。

questions.q: What do we know from the reading?
o: Jeans are a kind of shorts for women.
Straight jeans make people look shorter.
Boyfriend jeans are only for men to wear.
Flared jeans’ bottom is wider than the top.
questions.e: 由圖以及 They become wider from the knees down, and the pant legs are in a “bell-like” shape. 可得知(D)是正確的。(A)牛仔褲不一定是短褲(B)文中未提到(C)男友褲女生也可以穿。

questions.q: What does these mean?
o: All these four kinds of jeans.
Jacob W. Davis and Levi Strauss.
questions.e: 由前句說到 ... skinny jeans fit your legs. If you have long and straight legs... 可推知在此處應是指貼合腿型的 skinny jeans，故選(A)。

questions.q: Which does one mean in the reading?
questions.e: 前一句是說第一隻脫掉殼，第二隻穿上第一隻的殼，會脫掉舊殼換穿新殼的是「寄居蟹」。

questions.q: Which may be the best title for the reading?（title 標題）
o: The Life Story of a Hermit Crab
How Is Trash Bad to Hermit Crabs
Some Good Ideas About Using Shells
An Interesting Fact About Hermit Crabs
questions.e: 此篇文章主要是在說寄居蟹換殼時的特殊習性，故選(D)關於寄居蟹的一個有趣事實。

questions.q: What can we NOT know from the reading?
o: Hermit crabs look for new shells on the beach.
The smallest hermit crabs will be at the end of the line.
It is a good idea to give hermit crabs some man-made shells.
If hermit crabs can’t find new shells, they may take trash as their houses.
questions.e: 文章中沒有提到給寄居蟹人造的殼會不會是好主意。

questions.q: What is the writer trying to tell us?
o: Think twice before you buy something.
Be a smart shop owner and make more money.
When you need something, it doesn’t matter to pay more money for it.
Don’t spend too much money buying things if you don’t really need them.
questions.e: 全文提到商店販賣商品會用到的比較吸引人的行銷策略，但其實消費者得到的便宜並不如想像，並在最後提醒大家要當聰明的消費者，可知作者想表達(A)在買東西之前要想清楚。

questions.q: Which one is using marketing strategy?（選項見圖）
o: (A) Sorry. The tickets to UBX band’s show have sold out.
(B) News! uPhone will be on the market in November!
(C) Azus computer: 10% off only TODAY. Don’t miss it!
(D) House for sale. Three floors and with 4 bedrooms.
questions.e: 文中提到的 marketing strategy 是以一些吸引人的折扣或行銷來引誘消費者想要馬上購買，只有(C)的海報有提到只有今天有九折優惠，是引誘消費者馬上購買的字眼。

questions.q: What can we know from the reading?
o: Most shoppers don’t like to pay shipping fee.
People can use marketing strategy to shop wisely.
It is mean of shop owners to use marketing strategy to sell things.
In the first example, people pay $22 in total no matter which sale is chosen.
questions.e: 第一個例子中，三種銷售情況裡，消費者所需付的總額都是 $22，故(D)正確。(A)(B)(C)文中皆未提及。

questions.q: 第 38 格應填入？
o: I am so hungry and thirsty
that was some good lion meat
I need to prepare my lunch now
questions.e: 由下一段獅子想：「哇，這傢伙比我原本想的還強壯得多了。我應該在他抓到我之前離開。」，可推知狗看著骨頭並說：「那獅子肉真不錯」，才會讓獅子不敢靠近。

questions.q: 第 39 格應填入？
questions.e: 由上一段獅子原本以為這隻狗很虛弱，以及下一句我應該在他抓到我之前離開。可知獅子聽到狗說的話後，認為狗比他「原本認為」的要強壯的多。從「哇…」的語氣可知獅子當下已經改變了想法，(A)(C)現在式的敘述邏輯有誤。

questions.q: 第 40 格應填入？
questions.e: 由前面 if 引導的條件子句，可知主要子句應使用未來式。

questions.q: 第 41 格應填入？
o: Where is the way out of here?
questions.e: 由後句狗生氣地大喊：「…我一小時前就叫他帶另一隻獅子來給我了！」，從其中的代名詞「他」可知前一句必須有其所代替的名詞，配合前後語意，可推知是說「猴子在哪裡？」。
